summary: The old harness can reach the new spoiler rendering behavior through md_html; this candidate does not require maintenance.

assessment.necessity_reason: A finite fuzz input can place MD_FLAG_SPOILERS in the first unsigned word, zero renderer flags in the second, and ||text|| in the remaining bytes. The old harness passes all three to md_html, which forwards the parser flag and renders the resulting spoiler span.

before.requirement: Render paired || delimiters as a spoiler span when MD_FLAG_SPOILERS is enabled.
before.reason: The before span types contain no spoiler span, and the before collector handles pipes only as table or wiki-link marks.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The before pipe handler collects only single-pipe marks for table or wiki-link handling.

after.requirement: With MD_FLAG_SPOILERS enabled, render paired || delimiters as an x-spoiler span.
after.reason: For ordinary paragraph text, md_html forwards the input-derived flag to the parser. The parser collects and pairs double-pipe marks, dispatches spoiler span callbacks, and the HTML renderer emits both tags. The harness imposes no flag mask or output check.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: md_html forwards parser flags and Markdown bytes to md_parse and installs the HTML span callbacks.
Normal block processing analyzes and renders inline spans.
The spoiler flag enables collection of double-pipe marks.
Inline analysis sends double-pipe marks to spoiler delimiter resolution.
The pipe analyzer pairs a closer with an available opener.
Resolved double-pipe marks dispatch spoiler span callbacks.
The HTML opening callback emits the x-spoiler opening tag.
The HTML closing callback emits the matching closing tag.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The recipe compiles this fuzz entry and links the HTML renderer and parser libraries.

assessment.comparison_reason: The frozen spoiler behavior was unavailable before the change and has a valid route through the same old harness afterward.
